name: io.github.sauliusbeconis/axongate
description: Safe web read, search, cited answers, fact-checks and token checks for agents, paid via x402.

environmentVariables.name: AXONGATE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base (no ETH needed).

environmentVariables.name: AXONGATE_MAX_SPEND_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Total spend cap for the server process, in USDC (default 0.50).
